subject: Draft: Joint evaluation commitments canvas + demo week plan
messages:
From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@skyline.ai>, Mike Reynolds <mike@sablesystems.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Joint evaluation commitments canvas + demo week plan

Hi Emily / Mike —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. As discussed, I put together a lightweight, editable commitments canvas and a one-week demo schedule to accelerate your evaluation without adding overhead to your engineering team. The goal here is to make acceptance criteria and technical milestones visible so we can remove blockers quickly.

Quick summary of what's in the doc:
- Acceptance lanes: integrator, security, perf, UX acceptance criteria
- Week-by-week demo plan: day-by-day owners and required artifacts (sample data, test prompts, load targets)
- Risk & mitigation column for each milestone
- 'Decision gate' checklist for go/no-go at the end of the demo week

Links/attachments: Eval-Commitments-Canvas.gdoc (editable) and Demo-Week-Plan.gslides (timeline). Please review and put comments inline — I left a few open questions in the 'security' and 'data' lanes that I'd like to resolve before we lock the schedule.

Proposed demo week (high level):
- Day 0: baseline health check + connectivity (Redwood Private demo instance OR hosted trial)
- Day 1: integration of data pipeline + embedding ingest sample (owner: Skyline eng)
- Day 2: performance validation (50 concurrent infer requests, realistic token lengths) — we'll bring a lightweight quantized model to demo reduced cost modes
- Day 3: acceptance tests + edge-case generation (security/PII check)
- Day 4: stakeholder walkthrough + go/no-go decision

Can Jasmine and Jonas pick owners for the performance and security checkpoints on our side? Emily, Mike — what windows next week work for you for Day 0 & Day 1?

Thanks,

—Priyom
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference
attachments: [Eval-Commitments-Canvas.gdoc (Google Doc, 2 pages), Demo-Week-Plan.gslides (Slide deck, 6 slides)]

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@skyline.ai>
To: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Mike Reynolds <mike@sablesystems.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Joint evaluation commitments canvas + demo week plan

Thanks, Priyom — this looks practical and focused, appreciate the clarity. A few quick notes from our side:

- We can run Day 0 & Day 1 early next Tuesday (9/7) morning ET.
- Engineering owner for data ingest will be Mike — he'll handle sample transformations and a small S3 bucket with 1k sample docs.
- Security: we need to validate KMS integration and audit logging for any hosted demo data. Can your security engineer share a short checklist (SOC2 scope items + endpoint audit expectations)?
- For performance validation, our initial target is 40 TPS sustained at median 256 tokens — prefer to see both an mpt-variant and a quantized run if that's simple.

I'll add comments on the doc inline. One ask: can Redwood provide a short 'test harness' (curl/py script) we can run to reproduce the demo runs locally? That'll help our infra team.

Matt (cc'd) from procurement will also start a light SOW redline — not expecting anything blocking before the demo but want to align contracting cadence.

Emily
Head of Data Products, Skyline AI

Thanks — I can take the first pass on the procurement note.

—Priyom

Subject: Re: Draft: Joint evaluation commitments canvas + demo week plan — perf harness & next steps

Emily / team —

Good call. I've attached a tiny test harness and a short runbook in the shared doc (link below) — python + requests, examples for both hosted API and a local Private deployment (instructions for a 4-bit quantized run included). Highlights:

- Default perf target script triggers 50 warm requests then measures 60s sustained throughput; config: batch_size=4, concurrency=8
- Included two model configs: mpt-7b (fp16) and mpt-7b-q4_8 (quantized). I added recommended kernel hints for the runtime and a note on enabling prefix KV caching to improve tail latency for their user profiles.
- Security note: harness never writes tokens to disk; uses ephemeral env var for API key; logs sanitized by default.

Next actions:
- Jasmine, can you paste the KMS checklist into the canvas doc? I put a placeholder under the 'security' lane.
- Emily, can you confirm Tuesday 9/7 09:00 ET for Day 0 connectivity testing? We can block 60m.

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=0BxyzEvalCanvas (see tab: Perf + Harness)

-Jonas
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
